text: Soren builds the actual depth-2 QAOA circuit around last lesson's Hamiltonian -- cost layers and mixer layers, four tunable angles.
Qiskit's QAOAAnsatz builds that circuit structure automatically from the Hamiltonian. What Soren writes is the loop that tunes it.
A COBYLA optimizer, driven through Qiskit's Estimator primitive, repeatedly checks the circuit's expected cost and nudges the four angles toward a better answer.
The expectation values here are exact -- no shots, no sampling noise -- a clean parameter search before anything gets measured for real.
Next: binding these tuned angles into the circuit and actually sampling it.
